arStrings.szText: Fury Skill: While dual wielding, sweep your weapons inward, dealing damage with each weapon.

Each sweep also hits {c_number}{SF_11}{/c} additional time dealing {c_number}{payload:DAMAGE_MULTI_HIT}{/c}, and an extra {c_number}{SF_16}{/c} additional times while {u}{c_important}Berserking{/c}{/u}.
The initial sweep also creates {c_number}1{/c} {u}{c_important}Dust Devil{/c}{/u} that deals {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEB_DUSTDEVIL_TOOLTIP}{/c} damage, the subsequent sweep creates {c_number}2{/c}.

Sweep Size increased by {c_number}[SF_24 * 100 |%|]{/c} but Cast Speed is slowed by {c_number}[{SF_23}*100|%|]{/c}. Enemies caught at the outer edge of your sweeps and are hit an additional time for {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEC_OUTER_DAMAGE}{/c} damage. 

These additional hits grant this Skill {c_number}[SF_38 * 100|%|]{/c} increased Cast Speed for {c_number}{buffDuration:UPGRADEC_CAST_SPEED}{/c} seconds, stacking up to {c_number}{SF_39}{/c} times.
{c_important}Fortifies{/c}{/u} you for {c_number}[{SF_25}*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life for each enemy hit with both weapons.

Increases this Skill's damage by {c_number}[{SF_27}*100|x%|]{/c} per enemy hit for {c_number}{buffDuration:UPGRADE3_DAMAGE_BONUS}{/c} seconds, all stacks expire simultaneously and the duration cannot be refreshed.
Decreases the Fury Cost of your next {c_important}Double Swing{/c} per hit by {c_resource}{SF_28}{/c} once per weapon.
